主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. (CLB US) announced a cash dividend of $0.55 per share for Q2 2018, payable on 22 May 2018 to shareholders of record on 27 April 2018. The dividend represents $2.20 per share annually if maintained. Dutch withholding tax of 15% will apply. Future dividends depend on financial position, earnings, capital expenditure, share repurchases, and other factors. The company will host a conference call on 26 April 2018 to discuss Q1 2018 earnings.
